mechanism: Amoxicillin-clavulanate can cause antibiotic-associated diarrhea, and concurrent loperamide use may mask symptoms and increase risk of toxic megacolon or Clostridioides difficile complications.
action: Avoid loperamide during amoxicillin-clavulanate therapy; if diarrhea occurs, use alternative antidiarrheals (bismuth subsalicylate) or manage conservatively with hydration.
